**Optional: CSL Driving Life : Bus Driver.** Without it the bus runs as an ordinary line bus. Subscribe to Bus Driver (https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/163864/Windows, it brings CSL Driving Life : Core along) to drive it from the driver's seat.
**可选：CSL Driving Life : Bus Driver。** 不装也能当普通线路公交使用；订阅 Bus Driver（https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/163864/Windows，会一并安装 CSL Driving Life : Core）后可以坐进驾驶室亲自开。

**Sunwin SWB6109EV12G (iEV10)**, a 10.5 m electric city bus.
- **On its own** it is an ordinary line bus: put it on your bus lines like any other. - **With CSL Driving Life : Bus Driver** you can drive it from the driver's seat: full interior, working doors, mirrors, LED destination signs, the next-stop screen inside, and its own lamps. Bus Driver 0.11.0 or newer. - **Your own colours.** With Bus Driver you can put your own picture on the body (a wrap). - Capacity 80.
**Credits and marks**
The bus is modelled after the real vehicle, from the maker's published photos. The interior follows the Bilibili video BV1y7bv6UE2A (of the closely related SWB6109EV21G); thank you to its author. It is an approximation, not the maker's model, and no reference photo is included. The Sunwin name and logo belong to their owner. This pack is not made, approved or endorsed by Sunwin or any operator. If an owner objects to a mark or livery, the pack will be changed or removed.
— MeroT

**申沃 SWB6109EV12G（iEV10）**，10.5 米纯电动城市公交。
- **单独使用**时它是一辆普通的线路公交，可以像其他公交一样安排到线路上。 - **配合 CSL Driving Life : Bus Driver** 可以坐进驾驶室亲自开：完整车内、会动的车门、后视镜、LED 路牌、车内下一站屏和它自己的车灯。需要 Bus Driver 0.11.0 或更新版本。 - **自定义颜色。** 装了 Bus Driver 后，可以把你自己的图片贴到车身上（外皮）。 - 载客 80 人。
**致谢与商标**
本车参照实车建模，依据厂家公开的照片；车内参照 B 站视频 BV1y7bv6UE2A（拍摄的是同系列的 SWB6109EV21G），感谢视频作者。它是近似还原，不是厂家的模型，也不包含任何参考照片。申沃的名称和标志归其所有者所有。本车包并非申沃或任何运营方制作、认可或授权。如有所有者对标志或涂装提出异议，车包将修改或下架。
—— MeroT
